segments.en: Life, peace and all good forever, and mazal tov forever — to my beloved dear brother, my beloved — the delight who dwells in my heart — the dear young man who drinks living waters from Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman [מננמ"ח] — the distinguished Torah scholar, our Master R' Yisrael Dov the Breslover, may he live and be strong.
